project_type: Two-part app under /Users/milendrakumarbaghel/Documents/Hackathon/metaboquest/problem1: React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript SPA (frontend/) and Spring Boot + PostgreSQL + Flyway API (backend/). A second build (vite.playable.config.ts) produces a single-file offline HTML (dist-playable/index.html) with VITE_APP_MODE=standalone and HashRouter.
language: TypeScript (frontend, dense one-line-per-statement style, no semicolons, single quotes) and Java 25 / Spring Boot (backend, compact style like existing files)
build_system: Frontend: npm scripts in frontend/package.json (tsc -b && vite build; tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite but styling is mostly hand-written CSS in src/App.css, src/index.css, src/styles/learning.css). Backend: Maven wrapper ./mvnw. Git root is /Users/milendrakumarbaghel/Documents/Hackathon/metaboquest (problem1 and problem2 are siblings; ignore problem2).
test_framework: Frontend: vitest 4 + @testing-library/react + jsdom (src/test/*.test.ts[x], setup in src/test/setup.ts, fixtures in src/test/fixtures.ts), Playwright e2e (frontend/e2e/flows.spec.ts, Chrome channel, auto-starts `npm run dev` on 127.0.0.1:5173 via playwright.config.ts webServer), offline playable check scripts/verify-playable.mjs. Backend: JUnit 5 + Mockito unit tests and MetaboQuestIntegrationTest using Testcontainers PostgreSQL 16 (Docker is available).
build_command: cd /Users/milendrakumarbaghel/Documents/Hackathon/metaboquest/problem1/frontend && npm run build   (backend: cd .../problem1/backend && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests package)
test_command: Frontend: npx tsc -b && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:playable ; Backend: ./mvnw test. NOTE: `npm test` is vitest watch mode - never use it bare.
verification_instructions: Baseline before changes: vitest 35 passing, lint clean, ./mvnw test passing. After each FEAT run the FEAT's verification list. At the end run everything: backend ./mvnw test; frontend tsc -b, lint, vitest run, build, test:e2e, test:playable. Then run the banned-string scan from plan.md section 4. Never leave a dev server running (Playwright manages its own).
snapshot_or_generated_files: e2e and verify-playable rewrite PNGs in frontend/screenshots/ (expected, tracked files; fine to leave modified). dist/ and dist-playable/ are build outputs. submission/playable-ad.html and submission/playable-ad.zip are produced from dist-playable/index.html in FEAT-004 (cp, then `cd dist-playable && zip -j ../../submission/playable-ad.zip index.html`).
environment_constraints: USER RULES: do NOT git commit or push (overrides any generic 'commit locally' habit); do NOT add new automated tests (only repair existing ones broken by intentional changes); no secrets in files; no long-running foreground servers; no drug/brand names, before/after bodies, weight-loss promises or numeric kg claims in user-facing copy; Problem Statement 2 is out of scope. Flyway V1-V8 already exist (V6, V7, V8 untracked = unreleased) - next version is V9; do NOT edit backend/src/main/resources/data/glp1-question-bank.json because V8's checksum is computed from it. Use relative paths only inside the correct cwd; the git/worktree root is one level above problem1.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/.kiro steering found in the repo. Follow README conventions: backend README.md 'Data and medical review' section must be updated; frontend README.md/API_SETUP.md/.env.example document env vars. Honest content claims: never say content is medically reviewed unless a reviewer field is set (contentReview.reviewedBy / bank reviewedBy).
key_patterns: Backend: V8__seed_concern_questions.java is the template for V9 (BaseJavaMigration + @Component + CRC32 checksum of its JSON, deterministic UUID ids via id(prefix, number), prepared statements). QuizService.start() shuffles with SecureRandom and persists the selection through QuizSession.assignQuestions -> quiz_session_questions; submit() uses session.getQuestions(). Analytics: AnalyticsService.ALLOWED_KEYS whitelists metadata keys per event; V1 SQL has CHECK on analytics_events.event_type. Frontend: src/services/quiz.ts (startQuiz/completeQuiz/loadResult, draft in sessionStorage via src/services/storage.ts with 'mq:' prefix), src/services/analytics.ts (track() only in connected mode and with stored consent), src/services/config.ts (mode, steerUrl, safeUrl, steerDestination), src/data/approved.ts (bundled question pool + scoreLocal, imports the backend JSON bank directly), src/data/topics.ts, pages in src/pages, components in src/components, dialogs via components/ui.tsx Dialog. Brand tokens in src/index.css (--cream #f5ebdf, --rust #c04e2a, --maroon #661414, --ink #351d1d, --clay #b58777, --blush #e6cbbd, --paper #f8f2eb, --muted, --line). Global prefers-reduced-motion rule in src/App.css disables all animation.
directory_structure: problem1/frontend: src/{pages,components,data,services,styles,test}, e2e/, scripts/, public/, screenshots/, dist/, dist-playable/. problem1/backend: src/main/java/org/springboot/backend/{quiz,question,challenge,analytics,gamification,common,config,db/migration}, src/main/resources/{db/migration (V1-V7 SQL), data (JSON banks), application.properties}, src/test/java. problem1/submission: stale README.md + LOOM_SCRIPT.md only (to be replaced in FEAT-004).
